top.title: Dubai home sale transactions fall in third quarter amid regional uncertainty
top.teaser: The volume and value of residential property transactions in Dubai fell sharply in the third quarter of this year as buyers became “more cautious” amid regional uncertainty over the Iran war, according to a new report. top.impact_reason: Reflects a shift in buyer demand and market sentiment.
top.headline: Dubai home sales drop in third quarter amid regional tensions
top.summary: Both transaction volumes and overall sales values declined during the third quarter. Market reports indicate buyers adopted a cautious approach due to geopolitical uncertainty.
top.why: Transaction volumes and values directly reflect prevailing market sentiment and buyer demand.

top.title: Dubai gives building owners 12 months to comply with shared housing regulations
top.teaser: Landlords have been given a year to bring their buildings into line with new shared accommodation regulations after Dubai earmarked more than 40 areas for shared housing. The move came as the city cracks down on overcrowding and the illegal subletting of multi-occupancy apartments. top.headline: Dubai gives landlords one year for shared housing compliance
top.summary: Property owners must align properties with new shared accommodation rules within twelve months. The initiative targets overcrowding and illegal subletting across designated urban areas.
top.why: Landlords must adjust rental property management to comply with municipal compliance standards.
